articles.summary: MUNCIE, Ind., May 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- First Merchants Corporation declared a cash dividend on May 19, 2026 of $0.37 per common share. The dividend is payable on June 19, 2026 to common shareholders of record as of June 5, 2026. About First Merchants Corporation: First Merchants Corporation
articles.title: First Merchants Corporation Announces Cash Dividend
